summary.text: Scott Harriman is a Democratic state representative who took office in Maine House District 94 on February 25, 2026, after winning a special election, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is also a member of the Lewiston City Council.

paragraphs.text: Harriman earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine at Farmington in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a city councilor, and he has been affiliated with the Lewiston City Council.
Harriman won the special general election for House District 94 on February 24, 2026, succeeding Kristen Cloutier, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
